monitored_text: Manufacturing Partnerships See how innovative companies are using digital manufacturing to solve complex development challenges and launch successful products to market fast. Harley-Davidson Harley-Davidson Factory Racing engineers quickly iterate using Protolabs to manufacture quick-turn, high quality parts. Speeding iteration of injection-molded, CNC-machined, 3D-printed, and sheet metal fabricated parts, the team has turned to both our factory-based services and Protolabs Network. Read More NASA NASA partners with Protolabs to machine a crowdsourced, generatively designed part that was delivered in only 36 hours so the design could be presented at the PowerSource Global Summit. Read More Sonos As Sonos developed their Arc Ultra, Protolabs became a clear partner for accelerating Sonos' design from prototyping to production. Read More PURPL Rocketry Team Through a strategic partnership with Protolabs, Purdue undergrads are harnessing the latest in additive manufacturing to achieve their ambitious goals. Read More KTV Working Drones Working with Protolabs, KTV Working Drone sped up production, cut costs, and created complex print-in-place systems impossible with traditional manufacturing. Read More The Shuffler Working with Protolabs, Trainor Jim sped up product development, cut lead times, and scaled production more efficiently than with traditional manufacturing. Read More Protolabs x Makers Digital manufacturing is rapidly expanding what is possible for makers. We love to partner with people, programs, and social media channels that epitomize this and introduce new audiences to the magic of advanced manufacturing tech.
